local_call_selection: First actual _select_local_sequence invocation per agent per snapshot; retain actual original invocation order and all original candidates.
missing_peer_policy: Skip if any of three peers has no complete 8x3 known action sequence; never substitute current true peer plans.
model_context: Original public 8x252 policy history and frozen GRU, own current public state, three received delayed peer states; belief reference is the original common public reference. This delayed-relative context and local anchor are transport shifts from V7 training, disclosed and not deployment-qualified.
anchor: Actual locally selected own sequence + only received delayed peer sequences, not final centralized team sequence.
candidate_pool: Stable exact deduplicated union: actual original candidates, one-pass original generator on constant velocity, then generator on plain/structured response forecasts for each actual original candidate. Never iterate to convergence or generate candidates from future truth.
cost: Original per-agent _local_scenario_cost_matrix and original risk aggregation with captured actual delayed peer state. Copied-state reference score must reproduce the actual selected local score. All conditions compare one shared finite union, not the sequential solver or closed-loop return.
clone_rollout: Original local CBF and 8-step fixed joint commands on cloned current environment; independent common per-step sensor/execution noise; stop on termination. Truth is label-only, never candidate generation or model input.
limitations: Previously inspected development data. Candidate-generation changes, delayed-relative input shifts and reference-anchor shifts are exploratory. Shadow work runs after the original plan, so replay equality is not an online latency guarantee. Clone CBF outcomes are hypothetical joint open-loop branches, not multi-step feedback controller gains. No qualification gate is overridden.
